l.i: 12. De juramento ab aliis exigendo, Cautiones.

main_text.head: SECT. I.
main_text.p: Vinculi illius sive ligaminis, quod qui jurat ligat super animam suam, & de quo tam multa hactenus differuimus, Solutio hodiernum pensum est, & totius propositæ tractationis novissima pars. De qua solutione, antequam ad species descendatur, duo sunt in genere observanda. Observandum primo; vinculi solutionem peculiarem esse juramento promissorio, in assertorio locum non habere. Omni Juramento, sive Assertorio, sive promissorio, debet inesse Veritas: Jer. 4. 2. sed cum hoc discrimine, quod ad juramentum Assertorium unica sufficiat veritas de præsenti, cum in Promissorio duplex requiratur; una sc. de præsenti, altera de futuro. Veritas de præsenti respicit ipsum actum jurandi: & consistit in hoc, ut jurans quando jurat verum dicat; hoc est, ut mens sit congrua verbis, & ut habeat intentionem servandi id

page.notes: The catchword "quod" stands alone at the lower right and is therefore not repeated in the text. The left margin shows only edge marks and a dark strip from the scan border, which are not printed text. The first line of the page (the running head) and the page number 297 are printed as shown. The opening "V" is a large initial and is joined to "inculi" as "Vinculi". The "Cautiones" line break is read as one word from the two printed fragments "Cau-" and "tiones.".
